Another person, Person 2, is walking ahead of you the same way, 3 m ahead, in the middle of the corridor, as you are, and you are overtaking them. You will move to your left to pass. Tell Person 2 which side of them you will pass on, using their left or right: what do you say?

raw_output:
On your left.  
Since we are walking the same direction, my left is also your left, and I will move left to pass.
